name: I Bet You Look Good on the Dancefloor

info.album: I Bet You Look Good On The Dancefloor

podcast.body: This debut single by the UK post-Grit Pop band entered the British chart at number one in 2005. It is arguably the first act to achieve a chart-topper significantly hyped by Myspace. Despite the site's role, the band members reportedly professed ignorance of Myspace, stating that their fans largely fomented the activity on the platform. "UK post-Grit Pop band Arctic Monkeys was arguably the first act with a Myspace-fueled chart-topper."

srcs.source: Hit Parade Music History and Music Trivia
